threads.Author: reviewer
threads.Text: [Q] Coverage blind spot in the proposed primary metric: probes are generated from "the code the doc claims to cover", so a research doc that omits an entire relevant subsystem scores perfectly — omission is invisible to the eval. The findings never mention a scope/completeness signal (did the research look at the right code at all?). If the plan builds probe score as the leading quality metric without this caveat, it will reward narrow-but-accurate docs over complete ones.
